    Uploads

    Every template uploaded in this browser for the current platform: what came in, what it changed, and a way to restore or undo it. History is stored on this device only.
    How re-uploads work. Same customer name: each lab in the file replaces the lab with the same name (not case sensitive), new lab names are added, and labs not in the file are kept. Different customer name: the file starts a new customer quote; the previous one stays here so you can restore it.

    Users

    Admins add, reset and remove Launchpad users here. Each user only sees their own quotes and uploads.
